reason: The README clearly describes a read-only workspace file explorer with directory browsing and code or Markdown previews in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中浏览当前会话工作区的文件树，并预览代码和 Markdown 文件。
summaries.en: Browse the current session workspace file tree in the DeepSeek Harness web interface and preview code and Markdown files.

capabilities: Reads directory listings and text files within the current session workspace
Displays code and Markdown previews in a floating user interface
Provides host-client API routes for workspace browsing
